styleLock.direction: cool tech athletic street-commerce visual system
styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal #1B1B1D studio key visuals, dark grey #232326 industrial backdrops, ice-blue #DCEAF5 technical info panels, pure white #FFFFFF packshot and spec panels, light-grey #EFEFF1 flat-lay board, with cobblestone grey and blue-wall street surfaces reserved for lifestyle screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool directional studio key from the upper front-left at 5600K, clean even fill, crisp rim highlight along the knit edge, soft grounded contact shadows, cool natural street daylight 5500K in lifestyle shots, no harsh double shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte charcoal studio floor, ice-blue technical grid panel, light-grey matte info board #EFEFF1, cool grey cobblestone #8E9296 and weathered wooden deck #B9B2A6 in lifestyle shots
styleLock.typography: modern condensed geometric sans-serif headlines, no serif, no handwriting, no retro display faces
styleLock.iconSystem: thin uniform-line technical icons, airflow arrows, blueprint-style outsole line art and rounded rectangular info labels in #1F5FBF
styleLock.presentationRules: one shared slight 3/4 hero angle for the product across the set, stable scale and centering, the full product always complete inside the frame, perforated knit texture and ribbed chunky outsole geometry rendered true to the reference
noDrift: no readable brand, logo or shoe-label text
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool-toned athletic footwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1B1B1D, pure white #FFFFFF, ice-blue info panel #DCEAF5 and one tech-blue accent #1F5FBF; cool color temperature with cool directional studio lighting at 5600K, clean even fill, crisp rim highlight and soft grounded contact shadows; modern condensed geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded rectangular info labels, thin uniform-line technical icons and blueprint-style outsole line art; the perforated knit upper and the chunky ribbed white MD outsole always rendered true to the reference with visible texture; stable product scale, a shared slight 3/4 hero angle across variants and fully framed compositions; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 21 屏运动男鞋详情长图切片提炼；已剥离原品牌与鞋标可读文字、原中英文文案与独特排版、二维码与会员福利区块、模特面容与身份。原文数值（尺码区间、材质含量等）一律转为 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 短句槽位由商家回填，未写入任何检测、认证、销量或功效数据；信任镜只保留可验证的材质与尺码信息。shot-01/02 原右三分之一与左上负空间版式改为实文案直出并整体收满构图；shot-05/10 因分栏与信息版式保留较低产品占比并以版式为准。
